ops.question: How many minutes per month may the points balance and history screens be unavailable, planned maintenance included (LOYALTY/NFR-04)?
ops.impact: Confirms or replaces the policy-accepted 99.9 % availability target for the member points journey.

ops.question: Within how many seconds must an everyday action in the Refunds Portal complete (REFUNDS/NFR-05)?
ops.impact: Confirms or replaces the policy-accepted 2000 ms P99 latency target for the refund actions.

ops.question: What are the launch dates, hard deadlines and change windows of the Refunds Portal pilot, its rollout, and Loyalty Points (REFUNDS 04, LOYALTY 04)?
ops.impact: Sets the delivery envelope the option comparison reads (delivery time) and the change-freeze windows.

ops.question: Has CardPay Ltd confirmed refunds to the original card for branch card purchases, with its merchant account model, time limit, needed payment details, and whether it reports card disputes (REFUNDS 02 Dependencies)?
ops.impact: Can change how the payout integration works; needed before the build of REFUNDS UC-04.

ops.question: Has the Retail IT team agreed to give the receipt lookup and the member purchase feed, and how soon after a purchase can a receipt be found (REFUNDS 02 Assumption 4 and Dependencies, LOYALTY 02)?
ops.impact: Every refund request and every earned point depends on Point-of-Sale Records; needed before the build of REFUNDS UC-01.
